application_review: Disjoint local prime slots of different arities, including zero, group exactly into the original global master prime law. Polynomial renaming preserves evaluations and nonvanishing and derives the actual sparse replica-gap support condition.

The precise local good event excludes zeros and repetitions plus small-prime-power divisibility of one designated denominator polynomial. Exact same-pool marginalization and event monotonicity derive its probability tending to one from inclusion in the original fixed master list.

The exact separately normalized original local dual formula equals the global master variable-dimensional weighted quotient cube numerator divided by the actual product of local good-event masses. Original zero-based shift locations, natural quotient lengths and moduli are identified exactly.

For positive replica counts the normalized root-centered dual product tends to zero with numerator and denominator limits derived. The original master arity and polynomial list are independent of the number of replicated global prime slots; no desired convergence is supplied.
Empty independent coordinate products carry exactly unit mass, and zero-replica cube products reduce exactly to the original harmonic root expectation.
The actual zero-replica dual product tends to zero under original block, common-tail and root hypotheses, giving original mask mean one without a nonroot row or prime-only factor.

Every fixed replica count including zero and every stage-wise choice from a fixed finite family of dual template profiles has normalized product limit zero under one and the same original master family and fixed polynomial inclusion conditions.

The local good event has the preprint shape: only the chosen denominator polynomial is subject to the small-prime-power exclusion. The stronger full-master exclusion is used only to bound its probability from below, not to replace its conditional distribution.

The master polynomial arity n, list D, and family F remain fixed for arbitrary fixed replica count b. Independent global slots have their own arity r, and only a finite image of renamed nonzero replica denominators is passed to the cube proof. An initial draft coupling master arity to r was corrected before registration.

All normalized-limit numerator, denominator, W-divisibility and quotient-length convergence is derived. The theorem hypotheses retain local template inclusion, original common-tail and valid-gap hypotheses and actual pointwise test bounds; no numerator-limit or denominator-limit premise is supplied.

Local template polynomial construction and its inclusion in the fixed master list are still explicit inputs. The zero-prime case is admitted by the types and laws, but the specific extra constant-modulus template still needs its concrete local list/inclusion instantiation.

The finite-profile theorem covers different dimensions and prime arities between profiles with the same fixed master family. It does not assert any unproved quantitative rate or a moment/clipping conclusion.

StrongConjecture remains only a proposition in StrongStatement.lean. strong_implies_subtype still takes StrongConjecture as an explicit hypothesis. No completion, repository publication or award eligibility is claimed.
All retained proof sources, attributed PNT+ files and runtime/dependency pins are unchanged. Only root imports and registry changed among retained hashed files.
remaining: Construct/instantiate the actual correlation template polynomial families and their inclusions in one fixed master list (including zero-prime constant-modulus templates); derive original dual moments, clipping and dense models; finish concrete correlation integrality/direction/denominator data, Prediction/Alignment, nilsequence/cube inputs and final witness extraction.
